description: Use this when the host asks what a participant said, or wants their result, report or answers from an interview. Do not use it for meetings held on another service, for another account's participants or to transcribe a recording, and not to score, rank or reject participants: Tracy only reports what they said. It returns a participant's interview result: what they said to each question, the result fields, and a note for an applicant tracking system. By default it returns the primary result, the one the web app shows: the latest completed session, otherwise the latest partly done one. A person may have had more than one session; set all_sessions to true to list every session with its state and label instead. Each session says how many questions were answered and skipped, or that the count is unavailable, and its report state: ready, processing, failed, or no speech when the participant said nothing. A report appears shortly after a session ends, so a finished session can briefly have none.

all_sessions.description: Optional. Set to true to list every session, newest first, instead of only the primary result, for example when the host asks how many times someone took the interview. Leave it out for the primary result.

participant_id.description: The participant's id, exactly as list_participants or invite_participants returned it. Do not guess an id, and do not send the person's email address or name in its place: if you do not have the id, call list_participants.

name: get_results
title: Get a participant's results
